svg.title: Two committees, one corridor
svg.desc: Step chart since January 2024 of the Fed funds target upper limit and the ECB deposit rate. The Fed's upper limit falls from 5.50% in 2024 to 3.75% by December 2025 and rises to 4.00% in September 2026. The ECB deposit rate falls from 4.00% to 2.00% by June 2025, then rises to 2.25% in June 2026 and 2.50% in September 2026. Latest values: Fed funds, upper limit 4% (2026-10-17); ECB deposit rate 2.5% (2026-10-18).
svg.text: Policy rates, %: Fed funds target range (upper limit) and ECB deposit facility rate
SOURCE Federal Reserve Board via FRED (DFEDTARU) · ECB Data Portal FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV
